title: Defensive programming: CEL expression complexity limits
description:
CEL expressions have no complexity bounds.

1. Expression length unbounded — arbitrarily long expressions consume memory/CPU during compilation
2. Grid context builds all rows/cols/diags without size cap — 1000x1000 grid creates 2M Value objects
3. No per-expression evaluation timeout

Fix: Add MAX_CEL_LENGTH (4096 chars), skip CEL grid context for grids > 10K cells, document complexity guarantees. Both engines.
close_reason: CEL expression length capped at 4096 bytes. Grid context skipped for grids > 10K cells. Covered in baize-4xq commit.
